facts.fact: Sika Finance says Cameroon's submarine cable at Kribi is in use, and that Cameroon opened access to it to Chad in 2015.
Sika Finance says Chad has depended on Cameroon's digital infrastructure for 90% of its connectivity since 2015, its only other international route having been put out of service by the war in Sudan.

TCD.note: A second route is promised, not in service.

facts.fact: Sika Finance reports that on 15 May 2025 Cameroon and Chad agreed that CAMTEL would finish the Yagoua-Bongor link by end June 2025, activate Nana-Mbere and raise cross-border capacity to 100 Gbit/s.
Sika Finance says Chad's operator SOTEL buys connectivity from Cameroon's CAMTEL over a fibre interconnection in service since 2015.
